title: WorkflowSpec
description: JSON Schema for the workflow-execution-platform authoring-surface grammar (IR structure). Implements design.md decisions D8, D8a, D8b, D8c, D8d. Validates the PARSED document structure only (YAML or JSON); the restricted-YAML profile (no anchors/aliases/merge-keys/custom-tags per D8a) is NOT and CANNOT be enforced here - that belongs to the parser (task 5.6a). See README.md.

irVersion.description: D8d/D11: locked field name. Integer, forward-only migration. This schema only requires its presence and integer type; migration is out of scope here.

inputParameters.description: D8a: the workflow's derived signature stays flat, named, typed. Optional explicit declaration of the flat parameter names the workflow accepts. Each entry is a flat name (no dotted paths).

sessionState.description: D8a: declared once per logical session key, not repeated per binding.

steps.description: D8/D8c: array of nodes. A node is a plain Step, a branch node, or a map node.

outputs.description: D8c: top-level workflow yields - map of name -> Binding pointing into the top-level graph.

flatName.description: D8a: a flat, named parameter/key - no dotted or nested path. Reject any '.' character.

ociDigestRef.description: D8c: a step's service reference is ALWAYS pinned to a digest (@<alg>:<digest>), never a bare tag. Hard rule.

sessionWriteTarget.description: D8c: a write target - a session key a step's output may be committed to. Gating is automatic (D8c), never an authored flag.

secretRef.description: D8c/D7: a secret reference is a SEPARATE category, not a Binding kind. scope is writer|user.

binding.description: D8/D8a/D8c: discriminated union of binding source kinds. Note: 'secret' is deliberately NOT a Binding kind (D8c/D7/D10), which is what naturally excludes secrets from compute's 'using' inputs.

binding_request.description: D8a: flat name only - reject dotted/nested paths.

binding_item.description: D8a: forEach item binding - deliberately minimal, exposes raw item value only, no other fields.

binding_literal.description: D8c: literal constant. Value may be an arbitrary JSON value/structure, passed through opaquely.

binding_compute.description: D8/D10: compute binding - a JSON-Logic expression object plus a 'using' map of named inputs. Each 'using' input is itself a Binding (never a secret, by construction: secret is not a Binding kind).

node.description: A node in a steps/body list: a plain Step, a branch, or a map. Discriminated by 'kind' (absent => plain Step).

step.description: D8c: a plain step invocation. No 'kind' field (or kind absent). id unique document-scoped (not enforced structurally across nesting - see README NOTE).

branchNode.description: D8c: branch construct. cases is a MAP keyed by stringified selector value, and MAY include a 'default' key inline (per the documented example). yields is optional in the schema; the 'required when >1 step' rule is NOT enforced structurally (see README).

mapNode.description: D8c: map/forEach construct. source is a runtime-sized collection Binding; body is a list of nodes; yields exposes named per-iteration results.
